prompt: A bustling restaurant scene captured as a high-quality 3D animated film still shows lively interactions among diverse characters. In the center foreground, a waiter in a crisp white uniform balances a tray with four steaming bowls of noodles, carefully navigating between tables. To his left, a family of three sits at a round table; the father points at the menu while the mother pours water into a glass for their young daughter. On the right, a chef in a tall hat leans out of the kitchen window, handing a plate of dumplings to a busboy who reaches up eagerly. A golden retriever lies under a nearby table, chewing on a toy bone. In the background, two teenagers share a large pizza, laughing as they pull slices away. Colorful lanterns hang from the ceiling, casting warm ambient light that reflects off polished wooden surfaces. Steam rises visibly from the hot food, adding depth and realism. The texture of the fabrics, wood grain, and ceramic dishes is rendered with meticulous detail. The composition balances movement and stillness, with every character engaged in a specific action that contributes to the lively atmosphere of the dining establishment.
